text: June 2026: House wash at a Burleigh Heads home. Green algae streaks above the kitchen window on the rendered side wall were washed away, along with the grime on the aggregate path and driveway. We also cleaned the windows inside and out, including louvres, tracks and screens.
alt: Before and after of the side wall by kitchen window and path. Before: Rendered side wall with green algae streaks above a kitchen window, ne in Burleigh Heads
